steps.title: Submit Proposal
steps.description: Any token holder can submit a proposal. It contains detailed plans and reasons for community consideration.

steps.title: Discussion Period
steps.description: Proposals go through a discussion phase where members can ask questions and suggest improvements.

steps.title: Voting Phase
steps.description: Token holders vote on proposals, with voting power proportional to their shares. Votes are recorded on the blockchain.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.description: Approved proposals are implemented by the community, with progress transparently tracked.
